authorization_note: Authorized by explicit user instruction to execute only the frozen first_walkforward_v1 protocol on the N=62 cohort, preserve break_logit_v1/fs_v1, register by model_run_id, report OOS metrics without calibration/tuning/alpha claims.

walk_forward.cutoff_rationale: First cutoff is the earliest month-end at which build_training_set reaches MIN_SAMPLE_N=20 with both classes >= MIN_CLASS_N. Subsequent cutoffs expand by ~24 months. Horizon is the Batch-8 freeze as-of date used for data_quality.
walk_forward.test_rule: feature_as_of in (train_cutoff, next_cutoff_or_horizon]; labels known by horizon when assembling the eval set
walk_forward.threshold_policy: select_threshold on training in-sample predictions only; freeze t*; apply to untouched test window

prohibited_until_authorization: walk_forward / chronological_split / fit_and_score on the real cohort
